comments.author: Sonia
comments.body: One of the harder dungeons to get access to, but it easily surpasses FSD in usefulness. The goods are worth just as much and the items are even better. +1 geo/+1 recog hat from just the upper floor chests should tell you something. With the exception of doing FSD to grab the kox papers (or just buying them for 1.5-2m) I don't even see a reason to do FSD anymore now that I have this baby unlocked.
